name: Emulator 100% CPU Utilization & VBS/Hypervisor Bypass

name: Force Discrete High-Performance GPU for All Emulators & Games

name: Disable CPU Power Throttling & EcoQoS for Emulators

name: Lock Maximum Turbo GHz & Zen4/P-Core Priority for Emulators & Games
description: Forces Windows CPU Power Boost to Aggressive Turbo up to 5.0 GHz+, coordinates AMD CPPC / Intel Thread Director to prioritize games on performant Zen 4 / P-cores while distributing background threads smoothly, and maintains balanced APU GPU power headroom for zero thermal or frame throttling.

name: Windows Visual Effects - Ultimate Gaming Performance Mode
description: Disables window animations, menu fade delays, drop shadows, and taskbar transition latency while keeping crisp ClearType font rendering.

name: Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling (HAGS)
description: Offloads high-frequency video memory management directly to the GPU's dedicated scheduling processor, cutting frame latency and improving 1% low FPS.

name: DirectX Shader Cache Maximize (1GB+ for Zero Stutter)
description: Sets the global DirectX shader disk cache to 1GB to prevent in-game shader compilation stutters in modern games and 3D emulators.

name: Disable Fullscreen Optimizations & DWM Overlay Delay
description: Enforces true exclusive fullscreen mode and disables Windows Desktop Window Manager composition overhead for all DX11/DX12 games.

name: Disable Multi-Plane Overlay (MPO) Micro-Stutter Fix
description: Eliminates infamous DWM multi-plane overlay frame drops, black screens, and micro-stutters across NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel GPUs.

name: Disable Dynamic Tick (Kernel Clock Drift Elimination)
description: Stops variable timer tick drift by locking the Windows kernel timer to a constant frequency, eliminating micro-stutters and frame jitter.
category: âš¡ Extreme Low Latency & Kernel Timers

name: Force Hardware Invariant TSC Clock (Bypass HPET Latency)
description: Bypasses high-overhead motherboard HPET timer chips and forces Windows to synchronize with the CPU's direct on-die Time Stamp Counter (TSC).
category: âš¡ Extreme Low Latency & Kernel Timers

name: Enhanced CPU Time Stamp Counter (TSC) Synchronization
description: Enforces strict TSC counter synchronization across all CPU cores for seamless multi-core game execution and zero frame pacing hitches.
category: âš¡ Extreme Low Latency & Kernel Timers

name: System Responsiveness 100% Gaming Reservation
description: Sets Multimedia System Profile SystemResponsiveness to 0%, eliminating Windows' default 20% CPU reservation for background tasks.
category: âš¡ Extreme Low Latency & Kernel Timers

name: Unpark All CPU Cores & Ultimate Performance Plan
description: Enables Windows Ultimate Performance power scheme and forces CPU core unparking to 100%, ensuring all physical and logical cores remain awake and ready.

name: Win32 Priority Separation (Foreground Game Quanta Boost)
description: Configures processor scheduling thread quanta to 38 (0x26), granting 3:1 high priority boost to foreground gaming and emulator processes.

name: Disable Paging Executive (Lock Kernel & Drivers in RAM)
description: Prevents Windows NT kernel and hardware driver code from ever being paged out to disk, keeping all system calls directly in ultra-fast RAM.

name: Purge Standby Memory Cache & Process Working Sets
description: Instantly flushes stale Windows standby memory lists and frees fragmented RAM without needing third-party memory cleaners.
undoScript: Write-Host 'Maintenance action state is clean.' -ForegroundColor Gray

name: Disable Nagle's Algorithm (TcpAckFrequency & TCPNoDelay)
description: Disables delayed packet acknowledgment and Nagle's bundling algorithm on all network adapters, dropping multiplayer game packet latency to minimum.
invokeScript: Get-ChildItem -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces' | ForEach-Object { Set-ItemProperty -Path $_.PSPath -Name 'TcpAckFrequency' -Value 1 -Type DWord -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-ItemProperty -Path $_.PSPath -Name 'TCPNoDelay' -Value 1 -Type DWord -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-ItemProperty -Path $_.PSPath -Name 'TcpDelAckTicks' -Value 0 -Type DWord -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
undoScript: Get-ChildItem -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces' | ForEach-Object { Remove-ItemProperty -Path $_.PSPath -Name 'TcpAckFrequency' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-ItemProperty -Path $_.PSPath -Name 'TCPNoDelay' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-ItemProperty -Path $_.PSPath -Name 'TcpDelAckTicks' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

name: Optimize TCP Auto-Tuning & Multi-Core Receive Side Scaling (RSS)
description: Enables Receive Side Scaling to distribute incoming network packet interrupts across all CPU cores and disables high-latency TCP Chimney offloads.
invokeScript: netsh int tcp set global autotuninglevel=normal
netsh int tcp set global rss=enabled
netsh int tcp set global chimney=disabled
netsh int tcp set global ecncapability=disabled
undoScript: netsh int tcp set global autotuninglevel=normal
netsh int tcp set global rss=default

name: End Task With Right Click - Enable

name: File Explorer Automatic Folder Discovery - Disable
description: Windows Explorer automatically tries to guess the type of the folder based on its contents, slowing down the browsing experience. WARNING! Will disable File Explorer grouping.
invokeScript:
# Previously detected folders
      $bags = "HKCU:\Software\Classes\Local Settings\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\Bags"

      # Folder types lookup table
      $bagMRU = "HKCU:\Software\Classes\Local Settings\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\BagMRU"

      # Flush Explorer view database
      Remove-Item -Path $bags -Recurse -Force
      Write-Host "Removed $bags"

      Remove-Item -Path $bagMRU -Recurse -Force
      Write-Host "Removed $bagMRU"

      # Every folder
      $allFolders = "HKCU:\Software\Classes\Local Settings\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\Bags\AllFolders\Shell"

      if (!(Test-Path $allFolders)) {
        New-Item -Path $allFolders -Force
        Write-Host "Created $allFolders"
      }

      # Generic view
      New-ItemProperty -Path $allFolders -Name "FolderType" -Value "NotSpecified" -PropertyType String -Force
      Write-Host "Set FolderType to NotSpecified"

      Write-Host Please sign out and back in, or restart your computer to apply the changes!
undoScript:
# Previously detected folders
      $bags = "HKCU:\Software\Classes\Local Settings\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\Bags"

      # Folder types lookup table
      $bagMRU = "HKCU:\Software\Classes\Local Settings\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\BagMRU"

      # Flush Explorer view database
      Remove-Item -Path $bags -Recurse -Force
      Write-Host "Removed $bags"

      Remove-Item -Path $bagMRU -Recurse -Force
      Write-Host "Removed $bagMRU"

      Write-Host Please sign out and back in, or restart your computer to apply the changes!

      Set-MpPreference -SubmitSamplesConsent 2

      # Disable (Connected User Experiences and Telemetry) Service
      Set-Service -Name diagtrack -StartupType Disabled

      # Disable (Windows Error Reporting Manager) Service
      Set-Service -Name wermgr -StartupType Disabled

      # Disable PowerShell 7 telemetry

undoScript:

      # Enable (Connected User Experiences and Telemetry) Service
      Set-Service -Name diagtrack -StartupType Automatic

      # Enable (Windows Error Reporting Manager) Service

      # Enable PowerShell 7 telemetry
      [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('POWERSHELL_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT', '', 'Machine')

name: Temporary Files - Remove

description: Imports and activates the Ultimate Performance power scheme, locks 100% minimum CPU frequency, unparks all cores, and enables aggressive boost clocks.
invokeScript: powercfg -duplicatescheme e9a42b02-d5df-448d-aa00-03f14749eb61; powercfg -setacvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor 0cc5b647-c1df-4637-891a-dec35c318583 100; powercfg -setacvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor ea062031-0e34-4ff1-9b6d-eb1059334028 100; powercfg -setacvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor 5d76a2ca-e8c0-402f-a133-2158492d58ad 0; powercfg -setacvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor be337238-0d82-4146-a960-4f3749d470c7 2; powercfg -setacvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor 36687f9e-e3a5-4dbf-b1dc-15eb381c6863 0; powercfg -setacvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor 75b0ae3f-bce0-45a7-8c89-c9611c25e100 0; powercfg -setacvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor 06cadf0e-64ed-448a-8927-ce7bf90eb35d 10; powercfg -setacvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor 984cf492-3bed-4488-a8f9-4286c97bf5aa 1; powercfg -setactive scheme_current
undoScript: powercfg -setacvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor CPMINCORES 5; powercfg -setactive scheme_current

name: 🖥️ Direct Hardware Swapchain Presentation (Bypass DWM Blitting)
description: Bypasses Desktop Window Manager composition blitting for all DirectX 11/12 games, giving borderless windowed mode the exact latency and FPS of true fullscreen exclusive.

name: 🔒 Lock Maximum GPU Boost Clocks on AC Power (Zero Downclocking)
description: Prevents GPU drivers from dropping core or memory clock states during low-intensity game scenes, guaranteeing consistent framerates and stable frametimes.

name: 🎯 Pixel-Perfect 1:1 Raw Mouse Aim (Disable Mouse Acceleration Curve)
description: Disables Windows pointer precision acceleration curve in registry. Delivers linear 1:1 mouse movement essential for competitive shooters (CS2, Valorant, Fortnite, Apex).

name: 🛡️ Disable Windows 11 Windowed Game Power Throttling
description: Prevents Windows from categorizing windowed games as background power-saving tasks, keeping GPU and CPU running at maximum clocks.

name: 🧠 Intel P-Core & AMD 3D V-Cache Scheduling Overdrive for Games
description: Instructs the Windows kernel scheduler to pin heavy 3D rendering and physics threads strictly to high-frequency P-cores and V-Cache cores.

name: ⚡ Elevate CSRSS Process Priority to Realtime for Instant Display Response
description: Elevates Client Server Runtime Subsystem (CSRSS) CPU priority to Realtime, eliminating desktop cursor micro-freezes and window dragging lag.
undoScript: Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\csrss.exe\PerfOptions' -Name 'CpuPriorityClass' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

name: 🖥️ Cap DWM Maximum Queued Frames to 1 (Zero Compositor Lag)
description: Forces Desktop Window Manager to buffer only 1 frame instead of 3, reducing display input lag by up to 16ms.

name: 🧹 Auto-Purge Windows Standby RAM List (Fix Sudden 1-Second Freezes)
description: Flushes cached standby list pages before memory runs low, eliminating the infamous Windows standby list memory stutter in 8GB/16GB gaming rigs.

name: 🌐 Zero Network Packet Pacing Buffer for Instant Hit Registration
description: Bypasses network interface packet pacing delays, sending client bullet and movement updates to game servers with zero queue latency.
invokeScript: netsh int tcp set global ecncapability=disabled; netsh int tcp set global timestamps=disabled; netsh int tcp set global nonsackrttresiliency=disabled
undoScript: netsh int tcp set global ecncapability=default

name: 🚀 Disable GPU Ultra-Low Power State (ULPS) & PowerMizer Throttling (Force 100% GPU Utilization)
description: Disables AMD ULPS sleep states, NVIDIA PowerMizer throttling and GPU driver power gating across registry classes. Forces the GPU to maintain high 3D clocks and allows games to reach 100% full GPU utilization without GPU power drop.
invokeScript: 0..4 | ForEach-Object { $k = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\{4d36e968-e325-11ce-bfc1-08002be10318}\' + ('{0:D4}' -f $_); if (Test-Path $k) { Set-ItemProperty $k EnableUlps 0 -Type DWord -Force; Set-ItemProperty $k EnableUlps_NA 0 -Type DWord -Force; Set-ItemProperty $k DalDisableDisplayGating 1 -Type DWord -Force; Set-ItemProperty $k DisableDrmdmaPowerGating 1 -Type DWord -Force; Set-ItemProperty $k DisableStutterMode 1 -Type DWord -Force; Set-ItemProperty $k KMD_EnableComputePreemption 1 -Type DWord -Force; Set-ItemProperty $k PP_ThermalAutoThrottlingEnable 0 -Type DWord -Force; Set-ItemProperty $k ShaderCache 1 -Type DWord -Force; Set-ItemProperty $k PowerMizerEnable 0 -Type DWord -Force; Set-ItemProperty $k PowerMizerLevel 1 -Type DWord -Force; Set-ItemProperty $k PowerMizerLevelAC 1 -Type DWord -Force; Set-ItemProperty $k PerfLevelSrc 8738 -Type DWord -Force; Set-ItemProperty $k RmGpuPreemption 1 -Type DWord -Force; Set-ItemProperty $k DisablePowerGovernors 1 -Type DWord -Force } }

name: 🎮 Direct High-Performance GPU Routing & Bypass Hybrid Throttling
description: Sets default DirectX graphics scheduling to Dedicated High-Performance GPU mode, preventing games and heavy applications from running on throttled hybrid or low-power GPU states.

name: 🚀 Disable RAM Memory Compression & Page Combining (Zero Micro-Stutter Engine)
description: Disables Windows background memory compression and periodic page scanning tasks. Prevents CPU usage spikes and stops periodic 1-second stutters during BlueStacks, LDPlayer, and PC gaming.

name: ⚡ Universal Android Emulator & PC Game Hyper-Drive (BlueStacks / MSI / LDPlayer / PC Games)
description: Enforces Realtime High CPU & I/O Priority, eliminates Windows 10/11 EcoQoS Power Throttling, forces 100% discrete GPU routing, and locks 3:1 foreground CPU quanta boost for all Android emulators and PC games.
